_README: LOOKING FOR THE DATABASE CONNECTION STRING?
Local development -> appsettings.Development.json (committed, edit that one)
Deliberately blank here so a production deployment cannot silently fall back to someone's development database.
Startup fails with an explanatory message if no value is supplied. See README.md -> 'Configuration & secrets'.
_BACKUP_README: SqlDirectory is where BACKUP DATABASE writes the .bak before it is streamed to the browser.
It needs WRITE for the SQL Server service account and READ for the account the web app runs as.
SQL Server's own default backup folder sits under Program Files and is normally NOT readable by
the web app, so leaving this blank usually means the backup succeeds but cannot be downloaded.
Leave blank only when SQL Server runs on another machine, where the file cannot be streamed anyway.
